purpose: Core plugin logic: handles Notepad++ notifications, Scintilla subclassing, bidirectional scroll sync, render debouncing, and all user-facing commands.
called_by: PluginExports.cpp — all Npp plugin entry points delegate here
calls_out_to: PluginOptionsStore::Load / Save — persists options to INI
SendMessageW(nppData_._nppHandle, NPPM_*) — all Notepad++ API calls
SendMessageW(scintilla, SCI_*) — all Scintilla API calls
SetWindowSubclass / RemoveWindowSubclass — intercepts Scintilla scroll events
invariants: kScrollSyncThrottleMs=50ms minimum between editor→preview and preview→editor syncs
kCrossScrollSuppressMs=260ms suppression window after a cross-direction scroll to prevent ping-pong
Debounce timer fires 0/80/140/250/500ms after last edit depending on user setting
gotchas: Scintilla is subclassed (SetWindowSubclass) to intercept WM_VSCROLL, WM_MOUSEWHEEL, WM_KEYUP etc. for scroll sync; subclass must be removed on shutdown
Both Scintilla handles (main and second) are subclassed; the active one is chosen via NPPM_GETCURRENTSCINTILLA
Scroll sync uses both a source-line mapping and a ratio fallback — source line is preferred when the document has a known line count
